kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-image-baseline-check-summary --risk-level high --criteria Unauthorized_access --criteria-type BaselineNameAlias --page-size 20 --current-page 1 --lang zh --cluster-id c60b77fe62093480db6164a3c2fa50000 --scan-range container --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeImageBaselineCheckSummary

parameters.help_en:
The risk level of the baselines to query. Separate multiple levels with commas (,). Valid values:

high: high risk

medium: medium risk

low: low risk
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的基线的风险等级。多个等级用英文逗号（,）分隔。取值：

high：高危

medium：中危

low：低危
parameters.name: risk_level

parameters.help_en: The query condition of the baseline
parameters.name: criteria

parameters.help_en:
The query type of the baselines to query. Valid values:

BaselineNameAlias: baseline name

BaselineClassAlias: baseline category
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的基线的查询类型。取值：

BaselineNameAlias：基线名称

BaselineClassAlias：基线分类
parameters.name: criteria_type

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的数据的最大条数。默认值为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number to display from the returned results. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1, which indicates that the first page is displayed
parameters.help_zh: 从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。起始值为1。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The language type for requests and responses. Default value: zh. Valid values:
zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认值为zh。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the container cluster to query.
You can call the [DescribeGroupedContainerInstances](~~DescribeGroupedContainerInstances~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的容器集群的ID。
您可以调用[DescribeGroupedContainerInstances](~~DescribeGroupedContainerInstances~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: cluster_id
